name: Spider-Man
title: Friendly Neighborhood Web-Slinger

attacks.name: Web-Line Slingshot Projectile
attacks.description: Shoots high-tensile web lines onto nav links and menus, ripping them loose and slingshotting them across the webpage.

attacks.name: Web-Bomb Compression
attacks.description: Throws concentrated web canisters that encase menus and headers in massive spider-web cocoons and collapses them.

attacks.name: Acrobatic Spider Dropkick
attacks.description: Swings from web line and executes an acrobatic dropkick, slicing DOM components in half.

voicelines: My Spider-Sense is tingling... and it says this layout is toast!
With great power comes great element devastation.
